items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: I told Scott, you know Scott, the drummer, Scott Neumann, I said, “Scott, you do a tune too... I told the whole band to think up tunes... We did put that quartet tune together

ctx.x: Did you feel responsible for anyone else? For instance, your house band with the jam session, when it became obvious that this wasn’t going to be able to — did you feel responsible for those other musicians and trying to find a way for them to continue?

Yeah. And I keep after them, trying to explain, you know like normally at the beginning of the session actually we only do two tunes as a house band before bringing up the rest of the audience participants. And I told them, everybody should do a tune. I told Scott, you know Scott, the drummer, Scott Neumann, I said, “Scott, you do a tune too, you can just play it on drums or use a track.” He decided to sing. I told the whole band to think up tunes associated with Louis Armstrong so that we could keep our status…

Yes I had not done any of it myself. It’ll be curious to see if when you’re able to go back and make house calls so to speak, if any of the parents will say, “You know let’s stick with the online.” That wouldn’t be for you.
